title: Multimodal AI in Oral Cancer: A PRISMA-Guided Systematic Review.
zh_title: 口腔癌多模态AI：PRISMA系统综述
summary: PRISMA系统综述纳入2015–2025年82项研究，认为多模态AI在口腔癌诊断准确性与生存预测上总体优于单模态方法。
key_points: 多模态在诊断准确性、AUC与生存预测上更优
注意力、图嵌入与融合Transformer表现突出
reason: 系统综述纳入82项研究但为二手汇总、无新数据，按综述上限给6分
abstract: [Healthcare technology letters] Oral cancer presents significant diagnostic and prognostic challenges, often due to late-stage detection and tumour heterogeneity. Recent advancements in artificial intelligence (AI), particularly deep learning (DL) and machine learning (ML), offer promising solutions by integrating multimodal biomedical data. This PRISMA-guided systematic review evaluates over 82 studies from 2015 to 2025 that apply convolutional neural networks, transformers and graph neural networks to oral cancer, using combinations of histopathology, radiology, genomics and clinical data. Results indicate that multimodal AI models consistently outperform unimodal approaches in diagnostic accuracy, AUC and survival prediction. Architectures employing attention mechanisms, graph embedding and fusion transformers demonstrate superior performance in tasks such as early lesion detection and treatment outcome modelling. Despite these advances, challenges persist in generalisability, data standardisation and clinical validation. Multimodal AI thus represents a paradigm shift toward precision oncology in oral cancer, warranting further research focused on interpretability, prospective validation and ethical clinical deployment.
zh_abstract: [Healthcare technology letters] 口腔癌常因晚期发现和肿瘤异质性而带来显著的诊断和预后挑战。人工智能（AI）的最新进展，尤其是深度学习（DL）和机器学习（ML），通过整合多模态生物医学数据提供了有前景的解决方案。本项遵循PRISMA指南的系统综述评估了2015年至2025年间超过82项研究，这些研究将卷积神经网络、Transformer和图神经网络应用于口腔癌，并使用组织病理学、影像学、基因组学和临床数据的组合。结果表明，多模态AI模型在诊断准确性、AUC和生存预测方面始终优于单模态方法。采用注意力机制、图嵌入和融合Transformer的架构在早期病变检测和治疗结局建模等任务中表现出更优性能。尽管有这些进展，在泛化性、数据标准化和临床验证方面仍存在挑战。因此，多模态AI代表了口腔癌向精准肿瘤学的范式转变，值得进一步开展聚焦于可解释性、前瞻性验证和伦理临床部署的研究。

title: MambaSleepCVD for prediction of long term cardiovascular outcomes from polysomnography
zh_title: MambaSleepCVD：多导睡眠图预测长期心血管结局
summary: 基于耦合Mamba的多模态融合框架，用整夜多导睡眠图预测长期心血管风险，并在SHHS队列上验证。
key_points: 耦合Mamba做跨模态与时间融合
对比单模态专用编码与多模态自监督预训练
SHHS数据集验证，性能与基线相当或更优
reason: 方法有新意、队列规模较大，但仅单一公开队列验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Long-term cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk prediction remains a major global clinical priority. This study investigates how much prognostic information full-night polysomnography (PSG) carries after explicitly controlling demographic confounding, and whether combining specialized unimodal representations with continuous fusion mechanisms can effectively leverage it. We adopt a modular framework based on Coupled Mamba for simultaneous cross-modal and temporal fusion, capturing long-range dependencies and dynamic interactions between physiological modalities throughout sleep. With this capability, we assess whether specialized supervised representations from task-specific unimodal encoders offer prognostic value comparable to task-agnostic multimodal self-supervised pre-training. Validated on the Sleep Heart Health Study (SHHS) dataset, our approach achieves performance comparable to or better than current state-of-the-art architectures in the fully supervised, data-abundant regime, although the cardiac channel alone accounts for most of the discriminative signal. More importantly, we show that in the reference dataset chronological age strongly drives survival ranking; when provided as an explicit input, it can create a shortcut that obscures the contribution of PSG-derived physiology. Ultimately, our findings suggest that supervised unimodal experts integrated through a fusion engine provide a flexible pathway for prognostic risk ranking from sleep recordings, while reliable CVD screening will require independent external cohorts and explicit confounder control.
zh_abstract: 长期心血管疾病（CVD）风险预测仍然是全球主要的临床优先事项。本研究探讨在明确控制人口学混杂后，整夜多导睡眠图（PSG）携带多少预后信息，以及将专门化的单模态表征与连续融合机制相结合能否有效利用这些信息。我们采用基于 Coupled Mamba 的模块化框架，同时进行跨模态融合和时间融合，捕捉整个睡眠过程中生理模态之间的长程依赖和动态交互。借助这一能力，我们评估来自任务特定单模态编码器的专门化监督表征是否能提供与任务无关的多模态自监督预训练相当的预后价值。在 Sleep Heart Health Study（SHHS）数据集上验证时，我们的方法在完全监督、数据充足的情形下达到与当前最先进架构相当或更好的性能，尽管仅心脏通道就承载了大部分判别信号。更重要的是，我们表明在参考数据集中，实际年龄强烈驱动生存排序；当作为显式输入提供时，它可能形成捷径，掩盖源自 PSG 的生理信息的贡献。最终，我们的研究结果表明，通过融合引擎整合的监督单模态专家为从睡眠记录中进行预后风险排序提供了灵活路径，而可靠的 CVD 筛查将需要独立的外部队列和明确的混杂因素控制。

title: Learning to fuse and reconstruct multi-view graphs for diabetic retinopathy grading
zh_title: 多视图图融合与重建用于糖网分级
summary: 《医学图像分析》将刊出一项研究，提出多视图图融合与重建方法用于糖尿病视网膜病变分级；条目仅给出标题与作者，未见摘要。
reason: 仅有标题与作者、无摘要，方法细节与验证情况未知，最多给中等偏下档

title: Health-System-Wide Mapping of Demographic Information in Routine Clinical Histopathology
zh_title: 常规病理切片中人口学信息的全院级映射
summary: 预印本分析 130 万张 H&E 切片，用病理基础模型评估性别、年龄组与自报种族的可识别性。
key_points: 130 万张全切片、25 个器官、25.7 万患者
诊断分层后信号减弱但仍存在
reason: 样本规模大、方法清晰，但为预印本且无外部验证或临床结局
abstract: The extent to which demographic-associated information is detectable across organs and disease states in routine clinical histopathology remains unclear. Here, we analyzed 1.3 million hematoxylin and eosin whole-slide images from 257,322 patients across 25 organs, using pathology foundation-model representations and multiple-instance learning to systematically map information associated with sex, age group, and self-reported race. Across 69 organ-demographic combinations, demographic attributes were broadly recoverable, with pan-organ mean AUROCs of 0.828 for sex, 0.733 for age group, and 0.662 for self-reported race, and substantial variation across organs. Demographic-class balancing produced relatively small changes in performance, while evaluation within diagnosis-text clusters showed modest attenuation. Under training with diagnosis-based grouping, demographic-associated signals remained detectable across multiple organs, including sex in gastric tissue (AUROC 0.865), age group in breast (0.816), and self-reported race in skin (0.728). Literature-guided analysis of these settings generated candidate histomorphological and contextual explanations for further investigation. Together, these findings provide a systematic map of demographic-associated information in routine histopathology, informing investigations of its sources, assessments of potential shortcut learning, and the development of more interpretable computational pathology models.
zh_abstract: 在常规临床组织病理学中，与人口学相关的信息在不同器官和疾病状态下的可检测程度仍不清楚。在此，我们分析了来自25个器官、257,322名患者的130万张苏木精-伊红（hematoxylin and eosin）全切片图像，使用病理基础模型表征和多实例学习，系统映射与性别、年龄组和自我报告种族相关的信息。在69个器官-人口学组合中，人口学属性广泛可恢复，性别、年龄组和自我报告种族的跨器官平均AUROC分别为0.828、0.733和0.662，且不同器官间差异很大。人口学类别平衡对性能产生的变化相对较小，而在诊断文本聚类内评估时显示出轻度衰减。在基于诊断分组进行训练时，人口学相关信号在多个器官中仍可检测到，包括胃组织中的性别（AUROC 0.865）、乳腺中的年龄组（0.816）和皮肤中的自我报告种族（0.728）。对这些情况的文献引导分析产生了候选的组织形态学和情境解释，以供进一步研究。总之，这些发现提供了常规组织病理学中人口学相关信息的系统图谱，为其来源研究、潜在捷径学习的评估以及更具可解释性的计算病理学模型的开发提供了信息。

title: Deep learning screening of otoscopic images for ENT referral: development, validation and deployment of NHREF OtoScan
zh_title: NHREF OtoScan：耳镜图像深度学习转诊筛查
summary: 预印本报告以转诊决策为目标的耳镜图像深度学习筛查工具，合并三个公开数据集4763张图像进行开发、验证与部署。
key_points: 合并三数据集、划分12个临床类别
统一视野归一化预处理
聚焦非专科医生的转诊决策
reason: 多来源图像、面向转诊并已部署，但为预印本且缺前瞻结局，属值得一看档上限
abstract: Background. Middle and external ear disease is common and largely treatable, but accurate otoscopic interpretation requires training that is scarce outside specialist ENT services. Published deep learning models for otoscopy report high accuracy, yet most are optimised for closed set classification rather than the referral decision a non specialist actually makes, report uncalibrated probabilities, and do not report the near duplicate controls that video derived otoscopic datasets demand. We developed, validated and deployed a screening aid framed around referral rather than diagnosis. Methods. We merged 4,763 otoscopic images from 16 folders across three public datasets into 12 clinically meaningful classes. Every image was passed through a single field of view normalisation function (crop to the illuminated field, square, resize to 224 px, mask to one fixed circle) shared identically by training and inference, to remove the framing cue that otherwise identifies the source dataset. Because one source is video derived, images were grouped by cosine similarity of generic ImageNet features (threshold 0.93, joined transitively) and whole groups assigned to a single split, giving 3,326 training, 719 validation and 718 test images. A MobileNetV2 backbone initialised from ImageNet was fine tuned from block9expand. Probabilities were averaged over the eight dihedral transforms of each image and temperature scaled. The referral score was one minus the probability of a normal ear, and its threshold was set on the validation abnormal ears as the highest value still meeting a target sensitivity of 97%, applied with an inclusive comparison. Model selection, calibration and threshold were frozen before the test split was scored once. Results. On the 718 held out test images, referral sensitivity was 97.0% (95% CI 95.1 to 98.2) and specificity 75.6% (95% CI 69.4 to 80.8), with AUROC 0.974 for abnormal versus normal; a cluster bootstrap over the 363 similarity groups in the test split widens those intervals to 93.8 99.6% and 66.0 83.4% respectively. Of 501 abnormal ears, 15 were not referred; 11 of these were myringosclerosis and none was cholesteatoma. Twelve class macro F1 was 0.686, balanced accuracy 68.3%, and accuracy 85.0% (86.2% with chronic subtypes merged). Temperature scaling (T = 1.2) reduced expected calibration error from 0.0498 to 0.0430. A low confidence flag fired on 4.0% of test images, separating 87.2% accuracy on unflagged from 31.0% on flagged cases.
zh_abstract: 【背景】中耳和外耳疾病常见且大多可治疗，但准确的耳镜判读需要培训，而这类培训在专科耳鼻喉（ENT）服务之外很匮乏。已发表的耳镜深度学习模型报告了高准确率，但大多数针对闭集分类而非非专科医生实际做出的转诊决策进行优化，报告的是未校准概率，并且未报告视频衍生耳镜数据集所要求的近重复对照。我们开发、验证并部署了一种以转诊而非诊断为核心的筛查辅助工具。【方法】我们将来自三个公共数据集、16 个文件夹的 4,763 张耳镜图像合并为 12 个具有临床意义的类别。每张图像均经过同一个视野归一化函数（裁剪至照明区域、方形化、缩放至 224 px、掩膜为一个固定圆形），该函数在训练和推理中完全相同地共享，以去除否则会识别来源数据集的取景线索。由于一个来源是视频衍生的，图像按通用 ImageNet 特征的余弦相似度分组（阈值 0.93，传递式合并），整个组被分配到单一划分，得到 3,326 张训练图像、719 张验证图像和 718 张测试图像。以 ImageNet 初始化的 MobileNetV2 骨干从 block9expand 开始微调。概率对每张图像的八种二面体变换取平均并进行温度缩放。转诊评分为 1 减去正常耳的概率，其阈值在验证集异常耳上设定为仍满足 97% 目标灵敏度的最高值，并采用包含性比较应用。模型选择、校准和阈值在测试划分被一次性评分之前已冻结。【结果】在 718 张留出测试图像上，转诊灵敏度为 97.0%（95% CI 95.1 至 98.2），特异度为 75.6%（95% CI 69.4 至 80.8），异常 versus 正常的 AUROC 为 0.974；对测试划分中 363 个相似性组进行聚类 bootstrap 后，这些区间分别扩大至 93.8 至 99.6% 和 66.0 至 83.4%。在 501 只异常耳中，15 只未被转诊；其中 11 只为鼓膜硬化，无一例为胆脂瘤。十二类宏平均 F1 为 0.686，平衡准确率为 68.3%，准确率为 85.0%（合并慢性亚型后为 86.2%）。温度缩放（T = 1.2）将期望校准误差从 0.0498 降至 0.0430。低置信度标志在 4.0% 的测试图像上触发，将未标志病例的 87.2% 准确率与标志病例的 31.0% 准确率区分开。

title: Artificial intelligence for vascular minimally invasive surgery: techniques, clinical integration, and challenges.
zh_title: 血管微创手术中的人工智能：技术、临床整合与挑战
summary: 综述30项研究，梳理AI在血管微创手术中的预测分析、决策支持、图像分析与机器人自动化的应用与挑战。
key_points: 纳入30项原始研究，含机器学习与深度学习
覆盖预测分析、决策支持、图像分析与机器人
讨论临床转化、部署、监管与伦理问题
reason: 同行评审综述，系统检索但纳入研究仅30项、无原始外部验证，属综述上限档
abstract: [Frontiers in cardiovascular medicine] Minimally invasive surgery (MIS), including endovascular and robot-assisted procedures, is widely used for vascular pathologies but remains limited by technical complexity, cognitive workload, and postoperative complications. Artificial Intelligence (AI) may help address these challenges through predictive analysis, decision support, image analysis, and automation. A structured Google Scholar search was conducted from February 21, 2025, to January 1, 2026, and updated through September 2026. Peer-reviewed studies applying AI to vascular MIS were included, with additional targeted searches addressing clinical translation, deployment, regulation, and ethical considerations. Thirty primary studies were analyzed, including eight on machine learning, nine on deep learning, four on natural language processing, and nine on robotics or reinforcement learning. Machine learning supported risk stratification and outcome prediction, deep learning enabled imaging and segmentation applications, natural language processing facilitated clinical information extraction, and robotic systems supported navigation and procedural assistance. AI demonstrates substantial potential across the vascular MIS pathway, but broader clinical adoption requires stronger validation, prospective multicenter studies, standardized reporting, health-economic evaluation, and careful consideration of regulatory, liability, and accessibility challenges.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine] 微创手术（MIS），包括血管内和机器人辅助手术，广泛用于血管病变，但仍受技术复杂性、认知负荷和术后并发症的限制。人工智能（AI）可通过预测分析、决策支持、图像分析和自动化帮助应对这些挑战。于2025年2月21日至2026年1月1日进行了结构化Google Scholar检索，并更新至2026年9月。纳入将AI应用于血管MIS的同行评审研究，并进行额外针对性检索，以探讨临床转化、部署、监管和伦理考量。分析了30项原始研究，包括8项机器学习、9项深度学习、4项自然语言处理和9项机器人或强化学习研究。机器学习支持风险分层和结局预测，深度学习实现影像和分割应用，自然语言处理促进临床信息提取，机器人系统支持导航和手术辅助。AI在整个血管MIS路径中显示出巨大潜力，但更广泛的临床采用需要更强验证、前瞻性多中心研究、标准化报告、卫生经济学评估，以及对监管、责任和可及性挑战的审慎考虑。

title: Glyph: An Interpretability Engine for AI-Driven Scientific Discovery in Clinical Data
zh_title: Glyph：临床数据科学发现的可解释性引擎
summary: arXiv预印本提出Glyph引擎，用于解释临床基础模型的隐嵌入特征，以自动提取超出现有表型定义的新特征并支持疾病机制发现。
key_points: 针对预定义表型限制发现范围的问题
解释临床基础模型隐嵌入以发现新特征
预印本，未经同行评审
reason: 方法有新意但仅预印本、无外部验证或结果细节
abstract: Automated scientific discovery has the potential to advance understanding of disease mechanisms and accelerate identification of early disease markers. Manual data annotation is infeasible at population scale, motivating methods that automatically extract pre-defined phenotypes in multimodal and unstructured clinical data. Such pre-defined feature sets determine and limit which associations these approaches can discover. This limitation extends to agentic AI systems that use these tools to query population-scale data. In contrast, foundation models (FMs) trained on large volumes of clinical data can perform tasks beyond their training objectives. This suggests their latent embeddings may represent novel or unexplored features that could yield insights into disease mechanisms, yet such latent features remain difficult to interpret. To address this challenge, we introduce Glyph, an automated multistage framework that extracts features from multimodal and unstructured clinical data using FMs and sparse autoencoders, interprets them as coded clinical concepts, and evaluates their value for clinical scientific discovery. We applied Glyph to abdominal CT volumes, CT radiology reports and laboratory measurements from 41,628 patients across different institutions. We identified 397 predictive concepts supported by 4,463 Bonferroni-significant associations. Moreover, a majority of discovered associations were automatically reproducible in held-out cohorts across different sites. Glyph concepts provided complementary associations to literature-derived markers, leading to gains in predictive power. We envision that interpretability can extend beyond a mechanistic understanding of neural networks to connecting implicitly learned features with clinical knowledge and establishing their significance for patient outcomes. We release Glyph at https://github.com/StanfordMIMI/Glyph.
zh_abstract: 自动化科学发现有望促进对疾病机制的理解，并加速早期疾病标志物的识别。在人群规模上进行人工数据标注不可行，这推动了从多模态和非结构化临床数据中自动提取预定义表型的方法。此类预定义特征集决定并限制了这些方法能够发现的关联。这一局限性也延伸到使用这些工具查询人群规模数据的智能体式人工智能（agentic AI）系统。相比之下，在大规模临床数据上训练的基础模型（FMs）可以执行超出其训练目标的任务。这表明其潜在嵌入可能代表新的或尚未探索的特征，从而可能为疾病机制提供见解，然而此类潜在特征仍然难以解释。为应对这一挑战，我们引入了Glyph，这是一个自动化多阶段框架，使用FMs和稀疏自编码器从多模态和非结构化临床数据中提取特征，将其解释为编码的临床概念，并评估其对临床科学发现的价值。我们将Glyph应用于来自不同机构41,628例患者的腹部CT体积、CT放射学报告和实验室测量数据。我们识别出397个预测性概念，并由4,463个Bonferroni显著关联支持。此外，大多数发现的关联可在不同站点的留出队列中自动重现。Glyph概念与文献衍生标志物提供了互补关联，从而提升了预测效能。我们设想，可解释性可以超越对神经网络的机制性理解，将隐式学习到的特征与临床知识联系起来，并确立其对患者结局的重要性。我们在https://github.com/StanfordMIMI/Glyph发布了Glyph。

title: COMBIO: Automated Discovery of a Compact Composite Biomarker from Routine Laboratory Panels
zh_title: COMBIO：从常规检验面板自动导出复合生物标志物
summary: 预印本提出自动化流程，将梯度提升模型蒸馏为含整数指数的闭式复合生物标志物，并在六个任务上评估。
key_points: 用Shapley值筛选五项候选检验指标
复合式为检验值整数次幂乘积
含NHANES与肝病分类共六项任务
reason: 方法有新意且有留出测试集，但属预印本、证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Machine-learning models based on routine laboratory panels can predict outcomes but can be difficult to interpret and operationalize. We present COMBIO, an automated pipeline that distils such a model into a compact closed-form biomarker. The composite is a product of laboratory measurements raised to integer powers from minus two to two. The sign of each exponent indicates whether higher values of the corresponding measurement increase or decrease the composite. Shapley additive explanation values from the gradient-boosted reference model rank five candidate measurements and guide eligible exponent signs. An exhaustive search over small integer exponents selects the formula on an inner validation set, before evaluation on the reserved test set. We evaluated COMBIO across six tasks: three National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey outcomes, liver-disease classification in the Indian Liver Patient Dataset, and Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV in-hospital mortality and sepsis case-finding, with external evaluation in the eICU Collaborative Research Database for the two hospital tasks. Across the six test sets, COMBIO's area under the receiver operating characteristic curve differed by at most 0.03 from logistic regression using the five candidate laboratory measurements. The hospital mortality composite had an area under the curve of 0.698 in the external database. A version restricted to widely available measurements in the source hospital database achieved an area under the curve of 0.786 in a cohort covering 92% of admissions. The multiplicative representation provides compactness rather than additional accuracy, and local validation and recalibration are required before clinical use.
zh_abstract: 基于常规实验室检查组合的机器学习模型可以预测结局，但可能难以解释和落地应用。我们提出 COMBIO，一个自动化流程，可将此类模型提炼为紧凑的闭式生物标志物。该复合指标是若干实验室测量值的乘积，各测量值取 -2 到 2 的整数次幂。每个指数的符号表示相应测量值升高会增加还是降低该复合指标。来自梯度提升参考模型的 Shapley 加性解释（Shapley additive explanation）值对五个候选测量值排序，并指导可用的指数符号。通过对小整数指数进行穷举搜索，在内部验证集上选择公式，随后在预留测试集上评估。我们在六项任务中评估 COMBIO：三项美国国家健康与营养调查（National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey）结局、印度肝病患者数据集（Indian Liver Patient Dataset）中的肝病分类，以及 Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV 的院内死亡率和脓毒症病例发现，并在 eICU 协作研究数据库（eICU Collaborative Research Database）中对两项医院任务进行外部评估。在全部六个测试集上，COMBIO 的受试者工作特征曲线下面积与使用五个候选实验室测量值的逻辑回归相比差异至多为 0.03。医院死亡率复合指标在外部数据库中的曲线下面积为 0.698。一个仅限于源医院数据库中广泛可用测量值的版本，在覆盖 92% 入院患者的队列中达到曲线下面积 0.786。乘法表示提供的是紧凑性而非额外准确性，临床使用前需要局部验证和重新校准。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Ruijin Hospital; conditions: Pancreatic Mucinous Cystic Neoplasm, Pancreatic Serous Cystic Neoplasm, Pancreatic Pseudocyst; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 400; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Pancreatic mucinous cystic neoplasms (MCNs), serous cystic neoplasms (SCNs), and pancreatic pseudocysts (PPCs) often exhibit overlapping imaging features on endoscopic ultrasound (EUS). However, these conditions require different clinical management strategies. Accurate differentiation is therefore important for appropriate treatment planning. This study aims to develop and validate an artificial intelligence (AI) model that integrates EUS images and clinical features to differentiate MCNs, SCNs, and PPCs. The study is designed as an ambispective observational diagnostic study consisting of retrospective model development, prospective temporal validation, and a reader study involving EUS physicians. Approximately 400 adult patients with confirmed MCN, SCN, or PPC will be included. Retrospective clinical data and EUS images will be used for model development and internal validation. After model development is completed, newly diagnosed patients will be prospectively enrolled to independently evaluate the diagnostic performance of the model. The primary outcome is the patient-level macro-averaged area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (macro-AUROC) for three-class classification in the prospective validation cohort. Secondary outcomes include diagnostic accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, calibration, clinical net benefit, and the performance of EUS physicians with and without AI assistance. This study is expected to provide evidence for the potential clinical value of AI-assisted differentiation of pancreatic cystic lesions. No additional invasive procedures or study-specific treatments will be performed.

title: Mathematical foundations of artificial intelligence in healthcare: a systematic review.
zh_title: 医疗AI数学基础的系统综述
summary: 按PRISMA 2020系统检索2016年至2026年文献，纳入147项研究，梳理医疗AI的数学基础与方法趋势。
key_points: 检索三库，653条记录纳入147项

reason: 系统综述但主题宽泛、无新方法或临床结果，综述类上限内偏增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] Artificial intelligence (AI) in healthcare relies on diverse mathematical frameworks, yet their contributions to model development, evaluation, interpretability, and clinical translation remain fragmented. This systematic review synthesized the classical and emerging mathematical foundations underpinning healthcare AI and examined major methodological and application trends. Following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, studies published between January 2016 and June 30, 2026, were identified through systematic searches of Scopus, Google Scholar, and PubMed/MEDLINE, with searches conducted using Harzing's Publish or Perish v8 where applicable. Bibliometric analysis was performed using VOSviewer, while methodological quality was assessed using an adapted JBI-based framework and AMSTAR-2 for systematic reviews. Of 653 records identified, 147 studies met the eligibility criteria. Non-mutually exclusive mathematical-domain coding identified linear algebra in 100/147 studies (68.0%), calculus and optimization in 91/147 (61.9%), and probability and statistics in 79/147 (53.7%), highlighting their roles in data representation, learning, optimization, inference, uncertainty quantification, and validation. A separate mutually exclusive classification of dominant methodological themes identified explainable and trustworthy AI in 24/147 studies (16.3%), statistics and learning theory in 23/147 (15.6%), probability and Bayesian methods in 23/147 (15.6%), calculus and optimization in 19/147 (12.9%), and linear algebra in 15/147 (10.2%). Radiology and medical imaging were the leading healthcare application (24.3%), while classification and diagnosis were the most frequent clinical task (17.1%). Overall, healthcare AI is supported by an interconnected mathematical ecosystem. Emerging approaches, including graph neural networks, Transformers, and quantum machine learning, require stronger external validation, standardized benchmarking, and rigorous evaluation for reliable clinical translation.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] 医疗保健中的人工智能（AI）依赖多种数学框架，但这些框架对模型开发、评估、可解释性和临床转化的贡献仍然零散。本系统综述综合了支撑医疗保健 AI 的经典和新兴数学基础，并考察了主要方法学和应用趋势。遵循 PRISMA 2020 指南，通过系统检索 Scopus、Google Scholar 和 PubMed/MEDLINE 识别 2016 年 1 月至 2026 年 6 月 30 日期间发表的研究，并在适用时使用 Harzing's Publish or Perish v8 进行检索。使用 VOSviewer 进行文献计量分析，同时使用改编的基于 JBI 的框架评估方法学质量，并使用 AMSTAR-2 评估系统综述。在识别出的 653 条记录中，147 项研究符合纳入标准。非互斥的数学领域编码显示，线性代数出现在 100/147 项研究（68.0%）中，微积分与优化出现在 91/147 项（61.9%）中，概率与统计出现在 79/147 项（53.7%）中，突显了它们在数据表示、学习、优化、推断、不确定性量化和验证中的作用。对主要方法学主题进行的另一项互斥分类显示，可解释与可信 AI 出现在 24/147 项研究（16.3%）中，统计与学习理论出现在 23/147 项（15.6%）中，概率与贝叶斯方法出现在 23/147 项（15.6%）中，微积分与优化出现在 19/147 项（12.9%）中，线性代数出现在 15/147 项（10.2%）中。放射学与医学成像是领先的医疗保健应用（24.3%），而分类与诊断是最常见的临床任务（17.1%）。总体而言，医疗保健 AI 由一个相互关联的数学生态系统支撑。新兴方法，包括图神经网络、Transformers 和量子机器学习，需要更强的外部验证、标准化基准测试和严格评估，以实现可靠的临床转化。

title: Figure format and the accuracy of AI-assisted reconstruction of Kaplan-Meier survival data

summary: 预印本用模拟数据比较矢量 PDF 与 PNG 截图，评估语言模型重建生存曲线的误差差异。

abstract: Reconstructing participant-level data from published Kaplan-Meier curves supports meta-analysis and other secondary survival analyses when original trial records are unavailable. Researchers may use original PDF figures or screenshots, which can look alike but retain different information. We assessed how converting vector figures to images affects reconstruction by a language model that can inspect files and execute code. We generated 64 independent two-arm datasets across four scenarios combining 100 or 1,000 participants per arm with proportional or crossing hazards. Each figure was supplied as a native vector PDF and a matched 300-dpi PNG to Opus 5.5 through Claude Code under the same instructions. Outcomes compared reconstructed records with the original observed records: time-averaged absolute curve error through 24 months, error in the between-group restricted mean survival time difference, and error in the Cox log-hazard ratio. Native PDFs had lower curve error in all 64 completed pairs, including replacements for incomplete runs. Mean errors were 0.000029 and 0.1047 percentage points for PDF and PNG, respectively; the paired difference was -0.1047 (95% confidence interval, -0.1194 to -0.0909). PNG errors in the restricted mean survival time difference and log-hazard ratio were small: mean absolute errors were 0.0084 months and 0.0027. Lower resolution and compression increased curve errors; embedding unchanged pixels in a PDF did not restore vector accuracy. Some PNG runs exceeded the instructed revision limit, so results describe the implemented workflow rather than performance under a strictly enforced limit. Preserving vector information improved reconstruction fidelity in this workflow, but the observed differences do not establish clinically consequential changes in treatment estimates. Validation against reported survival summaries and event counts remains necessary. Generalization to published clinical figures and other model workflows requires further evaluation.
zh_abstract: 当原始试验记录不可用时，从已发表的Kaplan-Meier曲线重建参与者水平数据可支持荟萃分析和其他二次生存分析。研究人员可能使用原始PDF图或截图，它们看起来相似但保留的信息不同。我们评估了将矢量图转换为图像如何影响一个能够检查文件并执行代码的语言模型所进行的重建。我们在四种情景下生成了64个独立双组数据集，这些情景结合了每组100名或1,000名参与者与成比例或交叉风险。每张图均以原生矢量PDF和匹配的300-dpi PNG形式，在相同指令下通过Claude Code提供给Opus 5.5。结局将重建记录与原始观察记录进行比较：至24个月的时间平均绝对曲线误差、组间限制性平均生存时间差异的误差，以及Cox对数风险比的误差。原生PDF在所有64个完成的配对中曲线误差均较低，包括对未完成运行的替换。PDF和PNG的平均误差分别为0.000029和0.1047个百分点；配对差异为-0.1047（95%置信区间，-0.1194至-0.0909）。PNG在限制性平均生存时间差异和对数风险比方面的误差较小：平均绝对误差分别为0.0084个月和0.0027。较低分辨率和压缩增加了曲线误差；将未改变的像素嵌入PDF并未恢复矢量准确性。一些PNG运行超过了指示的修订限制，因此结果描述的是实际实施的工作流程，而不是在严格强制执行限制下的性能。在此工作流程中，保留矢量信息提高了重建保真度，但观察到的差异并不能确立治疗估计中具有临床意义的变化。仍需针对已报告的生存汇总和事件计数进行验证。对已发表临床图和其他模型工作流程的推广需要进一步评估。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Edozie Iweka; conditions: Analysis of Retrospectively Collected MRI Referral Data; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 900000; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Background Vetting and assigning of protocols to MRI scan requests are usually carried out by radiologists and radiographers. This way is both time-consuming and prone to error. Recent improvements in Artificial Intelligence (Al) like Large Language Models (LLMs) are better at processing human language. It could be used to improve tasks like image reporting and assigning protocols in radiology. Approach Firstly, I will find out about the delays in the way this is currently done. I will use a survey to find out the perceptions of radiologists to both the current process and the proposed Al intervention. I will then use an LLM to undertake referral and protocol tasks. I will compare its performance to the performance of clinical specialists and established guidelines. I will present the explanation reports to radiologists and ask them if they can be understood and whether they can be trusted as clinically reliable. Impact My research could help reduce the workload and time radiologists spend dealing with scan requests. The findings will help design future research to consider application in real clinical settings.

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Fudan University; conditions: Influenza Vaccination; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 1300; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] The goal of this clinical trial is to evaluate whether an AI-assisted primary care intervention can increase influenza vaccination uptake among patients with chronic diseases and to assess the cost-effectiveness and potential for implementing the intervention in routine primary care. The main questions it aims to answer are: 1. Does the AI-assisted primary care intervention increase influenza risk perception, influenza vaccine literacy, vaccine confidence, intention to receive influenza vaccination, and influenza vaccination uptake among patients with chronic diseases? 2. Is the AI-assisted primary care intervention cost-effective compared with conventional health education? 3. Is the AI-assisted primary care intervention acceptable, feasible, and potentially sustainable for influenza vaccination promotion? Researchers will compare patients with chronic diseases who receive the AI-assisted primary care intervention with those who do not receive it to determine whether the intervention improves patients' literacy, confidence, intention, and uptake of influenza vaccination. Participants will: 1. Be recruited and randomly assigned to the intervention group or control group. Participants in the intervention group will have access to an AI assistant for influenza vaccine-related information and will receive an influenza vaccination recommendation from primary care physicians, while participants in the control group will receive routine health education. 2. Complete a survey questionnaire assessing patients' influenza risk perception, influenza vaccine literacy, vaccine confidence, and intention to receive influenza vaccination. 3.
